messages.subject: Re: RCFile Format
parts:
Hi,
you need to create an input format for RCfile. In rmr2 parlance, an input format is created with

make.input.format(
  rmr2:::make.typedbytes.input.format(), 
  "binary", 
  streaming.format = "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.rcfileinputformat")

You can see I am reusing a private function, so we are stretching the flexibility of the IO subsystem of rmr2 a bit, but I think it's OK for an experiment, we may fix it later. Whether this works or not depends on, among other things, how well the data model of the RCfile format maps to typedbytes, a simplified serialization format for sending data to non-java programs. People using this approach to read Hive tables have run into problems because of the slightly different implementation of typedbytes therein. Let me know if you have additional questions and if the approach work out.

Antonio
